heroCopy: An architecture student exploring the relationships between place, people, and the routines that make a city feel alive.
bio: I study architecture at National Taiwan University of Science and Technology. My work begins with observing how people use space, how everyday routines shape a neighbourhood, and how design can bring overlooked places back into shared life.
interests: Current interests: adaptive reuse, public space, housing, and the social life of urban markets.
featuredSummary: Reimagining the everyday life of Taichung’s old city by reconnecting a traditional market, housing, work, and shared public space.
